quote: To evaluate the performance of an LM on SLING, we use perplexity for the causal LMs and pseudo-perplexity (Salazar et al., 2020) for the masked LMs

Two rounds of human validation were conducted on PCIbex (Zehr and Schwarz, 2018) to verify the quality of the generated minimal pairs. Eleven students from the University of Massachusetts Amherst were recruited as annotators for the first round, and five for the second round.
guideline: The annotators were shown one minimal pair at a time and asked to choose the more acceptable sentence.
